around.headline: Auto driver booked after roadside brawl with two women over a fare dispute
around.summary: A video of two women and an auto driver exchanging blows over a fare went viral, and the driver has been booked, per The Hindu and NDTV. Fare disputes are best settled by recording the ride details and complaining, not by fighting on the road.

around.headline: Rs 5.48 crore worth of MDMA seized in Bengaluru, 6 arrested
around.summary: Police seized 5.48 kg of MDMA and arrested six people in the city, per Deccan Herald and ThePrint. Report suspected drug dealing near your neighbourhood or campus to the police on 112.

around.summary: Waterlogging was reported on Srinivagilu, Thanisandra and other key roads, per News18 and Deccan Chronicle. With rain forecast to continue, avoid low-lying underpasses and leave early.

around.summary: Locals ceremonially 'opened' the still-unopened Pink Line to press for a launch date, per The Hindu and Deccan Herald. No opening date was reported, so keep planning commutes around existing lines.

around.headline: Hebbal tunnel study: IIT-Bombay backs short tunnel, IISc calls it biased
around.summary: An IIT-B study backed the Hebbal tunnel and flyover, while IISc experts flagged flaws in the report the BDA sought, per The Hindu and The Times of India. The dispute could shape how, and how soon, Hebbal's notorious traffic gets fixed.

around.summary: The government has notified a road grid for Bengaluru's urban expansion areas beyond the GBA, per Deccan Chronicle and The South First. It matters if you're buying or renting on the city's fringes.

around.summary: The Supreme Court will hear next week a plea seeking the Chief Election Commissioner's suspension from office, per The Hindu. It bears on how confident voters can be in ongoing electoral-roll revisions, including the one under way in Bengaluru.

street_smart.title: You're in an auto and the driver refuses to use the meter, demanding a flat fare well above the usual. You refuse, he shouts, and a heated argument starts on the road. What's the smartest move?
street_smart.based_on: The Hindu / NDTV / TOI: 'Auto driver booked after brawl with two women over fare dispute' (2026-09-29).
street_smart.situation: It's raining, you're late, and the driver is getting louder. Other vehicles are passing but nobody is stopping.

choices.text: Argue back, match his volume and refuse to get out until he takes you at the meter rate.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. A fare argument feels small, but shouting escalates fast, and once it turns physical you become part of the case too — as today's brawl shows. Winning the argument gains you nothing; the fare is not worth an assault complaint or an injury.

choices.text: Pay the inflated fare just to end it, and say nothing.
choices.feedback: It ends the scene but rewards overcharging, and the next passenger pays too. You also lose the chance to file a complaint while details are fresh.

choices.text: Stay calm, step out of the auto, quietly note the vehicle number and take a photo, then book another ride or walk away and report it later.
choices.feedback: Leaving removes the confrontation, and the registration number is what makes a complaint actionable. Without an argument on video, you avoid escalation and keep the moral and legal high ground.

choices.text: Grab his keys or block the auto so he can't leave.
choices.feedback: Touching his vehicle or blocking him can be treated as assault or wrongful restraint, turning you from complainant to accused.

takeaways: Note or photograph the auto's registration number before you walk away; complain to the Bengaluru Traffic Police or Transport Department with it.
Call 112 if you feel physically threatened — do not physically engage.
Prefer app-booked rides in bad weather so the fare and driver details are recorded automatically.

quiz.question: Which constitutional body does the Chief Election Commissioner head?
quiz.why: Article 324 vests the superintendence of elections in the Election Commission of India.

quiz.why: Jupiter's mass is more than twice that of all other planets combined.

quiz.question: Which river is the Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) dam built on?
